title: Plugin List Schema
description: List of plugins to install in EFDB. Schema version 0.0.1.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version used by the plugin list file.

plugins.description: List of plugins. Must be a unique list of plugins.

plugin.description: A plugin to be loaded into EFDB.

pluginName.description: Name of the plugin. Can only contain letters, underscores, and dashes.

pluginFolder.description: Folder location of the plugin. Can only contain letters, underscores, and dashes.
